name: Savior Valkyrie
description: The ultimate evolution of the Valkyrie lineage. Blazing speed and overwhelming Attack power make it the champion of champions.

ability.name: Valkyrie Ascension
ability.description: Savior Valkyrie's twin blades ignite with divine fury. The second strike now crits on 25% chance for +40 true damage. ATK scales with missing HP: +1 ATK per 5 HP missing (max +20, lasts 3 turns). After the Special, the next Attack ignores defense (Valkyrie Surge, 1 turn).

special_move.name: Saber Slash
special_move.description: Twin celestial blades strike in divine sequence — the second hit supercharges on a 25% crit, and every wound Valkyrie carries fuels its ATK for the next 3 turns!
